_note: Unresolved-evidence claims judged by tools/d59_unresolved_evidence_gate.py against the REAL D59 governor (drift_canary/unresolved_evidence.py, PR #2313). Empty 'claims' = explicit DORMANT (never a false green). The first claim merged activates enforcement with zero new wiring. Claims are evidence declarations: the gate rebuilds the rounds, the BOUNDED contract, and the reconstruction coverage from the declared evidence and runs the governor — a claim the governor refuses or disagrees with is BLOCKED (exit 1); an untrustworthy manifest is BROKEN (exit 2).

_schema.asserted_conclusion: BREACH | NO_BREACH | UNRESOLVED — what the team claims the governor finds
_schema.bound: positive integer — the BOUNDED fairness contract's service_bound_rounds
_schema.capacity_basis: non-empty string — what the bound was derived from (never an arbitrary timeout)
_schema.evidence_ref: link to the evidence (board comment, run log, check run)
_schema.reconstructions: optional list — required for every unresolved round when the governor finds UNRESOLVED: [{round_seq, status: open|settled|escalated, reason (required when escalated)}]
_schema.rounds: non-empty list of {round_seq (int), verdict: eligible|ineligible|undetermined, adequate_service (bool — must be a known bool), defects: [{component (one of the six D58 components), kind: MISSING|CONTRADICTORY|STALE|UNVERIFIABLE, detail (non-empty)}] — UNDETERMINED rounds must carry defects; settled verdicts carry none}
